name: mod-advisor
description: Recommends the right mods for your project and for what you're asking, with the commands to type, and installs them in one click.

repository.title: Repository
repository.description: GitHub owner/repo whose catalog.json lists the mods.

branch.title: Branch
branch.description: Branch the catalog and READMEs are read from.

autoOpen.title: Open the Advisor pane at start
autoOpen.description: Open the Advisor side pane when a session starts (it shows where the surface docks panes; elsewhere a band says what fits).

tellClaude.title: Tell Claude about installed mods
tellClaude.description: Add a short note to a prompt listing the installed mods that fit it and their commands, once per mod per conversation.

useModel.title: Re-rank with a small model
useModel.description: Ask a haiku-class model to re-rank the best matches for each prompt, in the background (costs a few tokens per prompt).
